about: Test data (synthetic, every text is a made-up 'Sample' abstract): edge cases for the Review desk judges (modules/review/review.js), run by test/judge-edge-cases.js. Each case states the behaviour we want. A case whose 'status' is 'gap' is a known failure of today's rules, kept on purpose so a fix can be checked against it (specs/003-judge-fidelity, REQ-032..REQ-037, proposed; tasks T010-T041). A case marked 'ok' must keep passing: the runner fails if an 'ok' case breaks, and reports (without failing) when a 'gap' case starts passing so its status can be flipped. Pair cases compare input a with input b, which say the same thing; single cases check one input.
base: Sample abstract (test data). We train a small model on 12 synthetic tasks and compare it with a baseline. Accuracy rises by 4% on a held-out test set across 3 seeds. Limitations: results are only on toy data. Code is available.
